system.description:
Like a wolf or a bear, you sprout wicked claws that erupt mystically from your otherwise normal hands — and feet, if you wish — and retract just as smoothly at your command.

Expend one Blood Trait; the claws extend at the end of the turn. They carry the bonus Trait Sharp, are useable in combat or for climbing, and inflict aggravated damage. Retest with Survival.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
